parameters.name: BSSID
parameters.description: If a MLD, the MAC Address of the AP MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID) which is reporting the Disassociation Event.

parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: If a MLD, the MAC Address of the Client MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: ReasonCode
parameters.description: The Reason Code received by the AP from the Associated Device (STA) in the most recent Disassociation or Deauthentication frame or sent by the AP to the Associated Device (STA) in the most recent Disassociation or Deauthentication frame as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-49}}.

parameters.name: BytesSent
parameters.description: The total number of bytes transmitted to the Associated Device (STA). For Multi-AP Agents that implement Profile-1, the units of this counter are Bytes. Otherwise, the units of this counter are as specified by {{param|Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.ByteCounterUnits}}.

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.description: The total number of bytes received from the Associated Device (STA). For Multi-AP Agents that implement Profile-1, the units of this counter are Bytes. Otherwise, the units of this counter are as specified by {{param|Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.ByteCounterUnits}}.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.description: The total number of packets transmitted to the Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: The total number of packets received from the Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: ErrorsSent
parameters.description: The total number of outbound packets that could not be transmitted to the Associated Device (STA) because of errors. These might be due to the number of retransmissions exceeding the retry limit or from other causes.

parameters.name: ErrorsReceived
parameters.description: The total number of inbound packets from the Associated Device (STA) that contained errors preventing them from being delivered to a higher-layer protocol.

parameters.name: RetransCount
parameters.description: The total number of transmitted packets to the Associated Device (STA) which were retransmissions. N retransmissions of the same packet results in this counter incrementing by N.

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: The time this event happened. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

parameters.name: LastDataDownlinkRate
parameters.description: The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the access point to the Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: LastDataUplinkRate
parameters.description: The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the Associated Device (STA) to the access point.

parameters.name: UtilizationReceive
parameters.description: The amount of time in {{units}} that the Radio has spent on the Channel receiving data from the Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: UtilizationTransmit
parameters.description: The amount of time in {{units}} that the Radio has spent on the Channel transmitting data to the Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: EstMACDataRateDownlink
parameters.description: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in {{units}} achievable in the downlink direction to the Associated Device (STA) if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}.

parameters.name: EstMACDataRateUplink
parameters.description: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in {{units}} achievable in the uplink direction from the Associated Device (STA) if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}.

parameters.name: SignalStrength
parameters.description: An indicator of radio signal strength of the uplink from the Associated Device (STA) to the access point - measured in {{units}}. RCPI is encoded per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-176}}, and described in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}). Reserved: 221 - 255.

parameters.name: LastConnectTime
parameters.description: The time in {{units}} since this Associated Device (STA) was associated.

parameters.name: Noise
parameters.description: An indicator of the average radio noise plus interference power at the access point measured for the primary operating channel to this Associated Device (STA). Encoded as defined for ANPI in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 11.10.9.4}}.

parameters.name: InitiatedBy
parameters.description: This parameter indicates the entity that initiated this Disassociation Event. {{enum}}

parameters.name: OpClass
parameters.description: Operating class in use at the time of this event, from {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}. May be determined from {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV}} and the Supported Operating Classes element in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV}}. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the operating class over which association messaging had occurred.

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: The single channel number of the channel in use at the time of this event. May be determined from {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV}} and the Supported Operating Classes element in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV}}. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the channel over which association messaging had occurred.

object.description: The events generated when an Associated Device (STA) disassociates from a BSS. {{deprecated|2.17|because a corresponding USP event is defined instead}} {{obsoleted|2.19}}
